meta.title: Initiator-Added Approvers: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and attempt to use Initiator-Added Approvers.
Repeat the same action as a Buyer in the same tenant and compare whether the action is offered or refused.
Observe or verify the tenant's RBAC configuration for Initiator-Added Approvers.
